title: spyre_v2 results bundle: bundle.json, schema_version 1
description: A sealed bundle is a directory (or .tgz of it) holding this file and every file it lists. `bundle seal` fills files, started_at and ended_at.

artifact_id.description: The tested artifact's spyre_v2 artifact_id; it must already be recorded.

artifact.description: Any `artifacts resolve` spec (id:<uuid>, image:<ref>@sha256:<digest>, ...); with artifact_id, both must name the same artifact.

component.description: The suite's owner, a test_case_id hash input (torch-spyre, spyre-inference, spyre-backend, ...).

run_key.description: Unique per run and tier source: `manual:<who>:<uuid4>`, or a Jenkins `<JOB_NAME>#<BUILD_NUMBER>` (then the run_id equals a connected v2Results run's).

jenkins_run_key.description: Alias of a Jenkins run_key; when both are set they must be equal.

run_url.description: The run's own page, if it has one; default: the processed bundle's URL.

tag_family.description: Jenkins run keys only: a manual bundle records verdicts, never tags.

runner.description: Where it ran: host, user, image (the pulled ref@digest), cards, ...

env.description: Free-form environment notes, kept with the bundle.

uploader.description: Who built the bundle; the relay records the Artifactory uploader instead.

files.description: Every file of the bundle but bundle.json. results/*.xml are ingested (JUnit or benchmark XML); attachments/ are kept, not ingested.
